name: Royal Lotus

sacred.shloka: वक्रतुण्ड महाकाय सूर्यकोटि समप्रभ। निर्विघ्नं कुरु मे देव सर्वकार्येषु सर्वदा॥
sacred.shlokaTranslation: O Lord Ganesha, of colossal form and radiance of a million suns, remove all obstacles from our sacred journey forever.
sacred.tagline: Two Hearts, One Soul, Infinite Love

venue.name: The Royal Lotus Palace
venue.address: Fatehsagar Lake Road, Udaipur, Rajasthan 313001, India

storyMessage: With the divine blessings of Lord Ganesha and the cherished prayers of our parents, we invite you to celebrate the sacred union of our lives. Under the celestial skies of Udaipur, amidst fragrant lotus blossoms and the holy Agni, your presence and blessings will make our celebration truly auspicious.
